evals.prompt: The Zotero Connector only saves a generic 'Web Page' when I'm on Al-Monitor articles like https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/10/example-story. Build me a proper Zotero translator for al-monitor.com that gets the headline, author, date, section and tags, with the article saved as a newspaper article, test it against the live site, and install it into my Zotero.
evals.expected_output: A lint-clean translator file (Al-Monitor.js or similar) built with the zotero/translators .bin tooling: site analyzed first, EM-based scrape with byline/date/section fixes, getSearchResults for listing pages, captured test cases including a multiple, all tests passing in run-tests, installed into the Zotero data directory translators folder with a kept copy, and clear restart/Update Translators instructions.

evals.prompt: can you make a custom zotero connector for tass.ru (the Russian-language TASS site, e.g. https://tass.ru/politika/26123456)? I already have one for tass.com in ~/Zotero Connectors/TASS.com.js, maybe reuse what you can. evals.prompt: My RT.com translator in ~/Zotero Connectors/RT.com.js has started failing its tests, and the Zotero connector now shows the wrong author on RT op-eds (it says 'Russia Today' instead of the person). Figure out what changed on the site, fix the translator, re-run the test suite, and reinstall it.
evals.expected_output: Diagnosis of the live page markup versus the translator's selectors, a targeted fix to byline parsing, stale test cases refreshed with drop-test-case + create-test rather than hand-edited, lastUpdated bumped, lint and run-tests passing, the file reinstalled into the data directory without overwriting other translators, and restart/Update Translators instructions.
